I wake up usually around 7 7:30 a.m. because during the week I always wake up at 7 or 7:30 a.m. So my body wakes up and I can't fall asleep anymore. What do you usually eat for breakfast? For breakfast, I normally eat oatmeal with lots of fruit, yogurt, and honey. But lately, I've been really enjoying avocado toast with eggs. I used to not like eggs at all, but now they're starting to grow on me, but my absolute favorite breakfast is a banana smoothie with kefir, chia, flax seed, and bananas. And what about you? I prefer to have slow mornings, but I like to keep my afternoons busy. So after breakfast, I usually try to either stretch or exercise or do yoga as a slow morning routine. Then I'll try to do something more productive. And in the evenings, I'll try to just read a book or watch TV and relax from a busy week. How about you? Do you prefer slow mornings or productive busy mornings on the weekend? On the weekend, I prefer slow mornings because I usually work during the week. I'm very busy and on the weekend I like to take things slow, wake up as late as I can, make a nicer breakfast, not just eggs, and I like to read, play video games, and go out on the weekend. Mhm. What do your afternoons look like over the weekend? In the afternoon, I like to go out, whether that's shopping or just for a long walk. It could be getting groceries, buying clothes, looking at furniture, and I sometimes visit my friends or my family over the weekend. And if the weather is nice, I go for long walks. How about you? In the afternoon, I like to go to the park, but I stay out of the sun because my skin is very sensitive. So, I either try to go outside in the shade or I stay inside in my house. Either or, not both. And a question I have for you is, do you clean your house over the weekend? Yes, I clean my house every weekend or I try to. I think the weekend is when I have the most time during my week. And do you do the laundry during the week or over the weekend? I send my laundry to get done. It varies. Sometimes during the week and sometimes on the weekend. Mhm. Do you listen to any music or podcasts? I listen to all kinds of music. Right now I'm really enjoying Right now I'm listening to more house music and R&B. Mhm. And what do your evenings look like over the weekend? In the evening, I eat dinner and I normally like to take my time to cook at home since I have the spare time to. It always feels so much more rewarding to cook and eat something. And plus, I can add as much salt or sauce or cheese as I want. They can be stingy at restaurants sometimes. Other times, if I'm feeling lazy, I will go out to eat or order takeout from a restaurant. Then after dinner, I like to watch a movie or listen to music. Listening to music and dancing in my room is something I always look forward to in the evening when I'm alone. And if I'm with my friends or my family, I prefer to watch movies and spend quality time with them and then I go to bed. What about your evening routine on the weekends? During the evening, I usually like to cook a nice dinner, maybe watch a movie or play a video game with my boyfriend. and I try to catch up on my sleep. Those are our weekend routines.
